description: This file contains functions for interacting with MTD devices specific to I-O DATA devices by MSTC, including reading and writing bytes, setting flags, and handling environment preparation failures.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Handles failure scenarios by unmounting all filesystems and rebooting the system.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_rw_byte
methods.description: Reads or writes a single byte to an MTD device at a specified offset.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_set_flag
methods.description: Sets a specific flag in an MTD device for I-O DATA MSTC devices after validating current flag values.
